$comment: Root ADR-0280 §4, ADR-0401 §1. The data.go.kr file data the platform collects: where each file is asked for, what it must look like, how its rows are keyed and how they reach a parcel or a 법정동. The collector (`collect-data-go-kr-file-data` in services/foundation-outbox-publisher) iterates `files` (keyed by dataset_slug, the catalog's), the Silver loads and their tests read this file; nothing else restates these values. One run asks each selected file's metadata once and fetches a file only when its atchFileId is new. The per-run cap is the files themselves: measured 2026-11-04, the eight files beside the registered factory are about 15.5 MB together plus the 349 MB 상가(상권) zip (59 s), so a run that finds every one new lands about 365 MB in about 3 minutes with the spacing.
user_agent: foundation-platform-data-go-kr-file-collector/2 (+root ADR-0280, ADR-0401; one check per file per day)

metadata.$comment: The portal's own two steps: the metadata answer names the current file (atchFileId), then the file is fetched by that id. A new atchFileId is a new edition; the same one is never fetched twice.

member.$comment: The data member of the zip: the CSV whose name ends with _<기준일 YYYYMMDD>.csv. The dictionary members beside it are not data.

bounds.$comment: A refused file loads nothing. min_rows is the first edition's floor (220,705 measured, minus about 10%); max_shrink_share refuses an edition smaller than the last loaded one by more than this share.

silver_load.$comment: What one Silver load may take (plan-silver-load-objects): zips of this source that no commit of silver.registered_factory records, landed within window_days, oldest first, one per run (each is a whole edition). The window stays shorter than the snapshot retention (lakehouse-maintenance.contract.json retain_days, refused otherwise): an expired snapshot takes its load record with it.

pnu_resolution.$comment: ADR-0280 §4. The provider gives no PNU. A row's address is read as a jibun address or a road address; each step names itself in pnu_basis, and a row no step resolves keeps pnu null with pnu_unresolved_reason. Never by geometry. jibun_address: 시도·시군구·읍면동(·리) names match reference.legal_dong_code_snapshot's current full_name, plus 산 and 본번-부번, and the PNU must be a current row of silver.parcel_boundaries. road_address: 시도·시군구·도로명·건물번호 match silver.building_register_titles.road_address_raw read the same way, and every matching title must carry the same pnu. A sample of 2,829 road addresses on 2026-10-19 resolved 82.9% to one PNU, 4.7% to several, 12.4% to none.
pnu_resolution.sido_prefixes_from: address_pnu.sido_prefixes: the 법정동 code table (reference.legal_dong_code_snapshot, every status) and the recorded 시도 pairs (legal_dong_code_change_views.region_pairs), read each load; no 시도 code is written here (root ADR-0403, ADR-0103 §2)

registered_factory.measured: 2026-10-19: one zip (about 6 MB) holding one CP949 CSV of 220,705 rows and five columns, plus a data dictionary; about 93% of addresses are road addresses. The provider publishes about once a year (기준일 in the member name). 2026-11-04: the same file id, byte-identical to the Bronze object.

row_key.$comment: An edition is one 기준연월. Only the keys of the periods it holds are compared, so last month's rows stay current and the months pile up (ADR-0401 §3); a code that leaves within a month gets its removal marker.
